actual_tools: public ClinVar, Ensembl, and Reactome records
execution.implementation: allele-specific rs7903146 C>T identifier path assembled from retained public records; genuine Rosalind launcher observation recorded separately

observations: ClinVar Variation 7413 identifies the selected rs7903146 C>T allele as an intronic TCF7L2 record; the distinct C>G record is excluded.
The local calculation retains four nodes and three source-backed links from the selected allele to TCF7L2 and Reactome pathway R-HSA-201722.
A genuine Rosalind launcher call returned ready=true but performed no variant retrieval, classification, or pathway calculation.
interpretation: The identifier path supports a cautious connection from the selected allele to curated TCF7L2 pathway records; it does not establish a variant mechanism or clinical causality.
limitations: Public records may change after the recorded access date.
No tissue-specific regulation, expression, chromatin, perturbation, phenotype, or clinical evidence is analyzed.
Rosalind launcher readiness is independent of the public evidence and local identifier-path calculation.

provenance.note: The source note and receipt preserve the allele-specific identifiers and three sourced links. The Rosalind observation records only chooser readiness and did not produce the scientific path.

reproduction: Read the case guide and public evidence note, keeping the C>T and C>G alleles separate.
Verify the four nodes, three sourced links, and exclusion check in outputs/verification-receipt.json.
